title: Compute a triangular-strip chromatic polynomial by transfer matrix

source.citation: Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, Jesús Salas, and Alan D. Sokal, Transfer Matrices and Partition-Function Zeros for Antiferromagnetic Potts Models III: Triangular-Lattice Chromatic Polynomial, arXiv:cond-mat/0204587

translation.notes: The published width-three free-boundary transfer matrix and vectors are encoded over Z[q]. Computing V T^2 U gives the exact length-three strip polynomial and verifies its evaluations at two, three and four colors.
